subject: CascadeAI demo — evaluation roadmap & ownership (proposed)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@cascadeai.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cascadeai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 26, 2027 at 3:12 PM PDT
Subject: CascadeAI demo — evaluation roadmap & ownership (proposed)

Hi Sophie / Tom —

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and clear use cases on ingest + retrieval + customer-response summarization. Per our demo and the broad success signals you outlined, I put together a concise evaluation roadmap and owner matrix so we can get aligned quickly. Please review and flag anything that needs changing.

Proposed evaluation (2–3 week sprint):
- Objective: Validate end-to-end accuracy and latency on three representative query sets (support tickets, onboarding FAQs, billing).
- Success criteria (pass if all met):
  - >= 92% intent match on labeled eval set (per your annotator sample)
  - 95th percentile response latency < 450 ms for Typical queries (1–2k tokens total round-trip)
  - Cost: projected cost per 1k input tokens < $0.30 under the evaluated workload profile
  - No PII leakage in 5 random red-team prompts (privacy check)

Scope & deliverables:
- Redwood: provide a hosted evaluation harness (preconfigured prompt templates, batch-runner, KV-cache enabled model variant), baseline model configs, and a short runbook for ingestion and auth. (Owner: Rishi)
- CascadeAI: share sample data subsets, evaluation labels, and temp test credentials (Owner: Sophie)
- Ops: setup access, schedule kickoff, and confirm monitoring hooks for cost/latency breakdowns (Owner: Monica)

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): align success criteria & sign MOU to proceed
- Week 1: ingest sample data, run baseline evaluation, triage any schema mapping issues
- Week 2: run tuned evaluation, measure metrics, iterate on prompts/configs
- End Week 2 / Week 3: deliver final report + recommendations and decision checkpoint

Attachments: I attached a short evaluation checklist (cascadeai-eval-checklist.xlsx) and a draft MOU (mou-draft-cascadeai.docx).

Next steps I need from you by Wednesday:
1) Confirm success criteria above (or propose edits)
2) Grant a temporary test S3 endpoint and read-only credentials (or an equivalent bucket)
3) Point us to the primary technical contact for data mapping

Suggested kickoff slots (PDT): Tue 5/4 10–11am, Wed 5/5 2–3pm, Thu 5/6 9–10am. Let me know what works and we’ll lock it.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@cascadeai.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cascadeai.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 27, 2027 at 9:18 AM PDT
Subject: Re: CascadeAI demo — evaluation roadmap & ownership (proposed)

Laura —

Thanks for the clear plan and the checklist — this is very helpful. A few quick notes from our side:

- Timeline: given a legal review and a data extraction window on our side, can we extend the sprint to 3 weeks? That gives us buffer to sanitize a second dataset for the privacy checks.
- Success criteria: we agree on the intent match and latency targets. Can you also include an explicit throughput / concurrency target (we typically run 8 concurrent agents during peak business hours)?
- Cost metric: can you add projected cost per 1k tokens and an estimated total for the 3-week run (approx)? That helps us build the business case.

I’ve attached a tiny file with the service account name and the initial bucket path (cascadeai-auth-details.txt) so you can start the access request.

We’ll make Sophie Lee (product ops) the technical contact for data mapping — she’s looped into the follow-up meeting I’ll schedule. Tom (cc) is our procurement lead — he’ll coordinate the MOU review.

We can do the kickoff the week of 5/10 — Tue 5/11 11am PDT or Thu 5/13 1pm PDT are our best slots.

Subject: Re: CascadeAI demo — evaluation roadmap & ownership (proposed)

Thanks Sophie — great context and helpful asks.

Quick responses and updates:
- We’re fine extending to a 3-week evaluation given your legal/data prep needs — timeline revised accordingly.
- We’ll add a throughput target: maintain 8 concurrent sessions with p95 latency < 650 ms (we’ll include a concurrency load profile in the test harness).
- Preliminary cost estimate: $0.28 per 1k input tokens (baseline model) — projected ~ $1,200 total for a 3-week run based on the sample volumes you provided. We’ll run a sensitivity table in the final report.

Action items I’ve taken:
- Rishi will provision the hosted test harness, set concurrency/load profiles, and run the baseline (Owner: Rishi).
- Monica will own the monitoring hooks and drive the kickoff scheduling (Owner: Monica).
- I’ll update the checklist and the MOU draft and upload both to the shared Drive link.

Attachments: redwood-test-harness-scope.pdf (scope + what we need from CascadeAI).

From a kickoff perspective, we can do Tue 5/11 11am PDT — I’ll hold that slot tentatively and send a calendar invite once you confirm the technical contact.
